From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: 2029-10-29T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: EdgeLens usage spike — quick 20m to review?

Hi Lisa —

Automated telemetry flagged a sustained uptick in token usage for your org over the last 48h (mostly /generate and embedding calls). I pulled a short threshold report attached so you have the context.

We usually offer a quick 20-minute technical huddle to:
- walk through what's driving the spike,
- share simple batching/cache suggestions that save $/token,
- confirm you're on the most cost-effective model/quantization profile for inference.

If useful, Markus (our AE on the account) can join to map any follow-ups. A couple slot options below — pick whatever works and I’ll lock it:
- Tue 10/30 10:00–10:20 PT
- Tue 10/30 14:00–14:20 PT
- Wed 10/31 09:00–09:20 PT

If none fit, drop a couple times that do and we’ll adapt.

Thanks —
Priyom
SDR, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: edgelens_threshold_report.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Thanks for the heads up and for the report, really helpful. We did push a new batch-annotation microservice on Tuesday that could explain the surge. Would love a short session — the 10/30 14:00 PT slot looks good for us.

One ask: can we include our infra lead, infra@edgelens.ai, on the call? They’ll want to review latency traces and token mix.

Also, quick note — can you send any pre-read or a one-page outline of what you’d cover? Helps set expectations with our SRE.

Cheers,
